text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"CA","level":"state","category":"screening_restrictions","status":"in_force","title":"California FEHA housing provisions: source of income, aggregate income and credit history with government rent subsidy","requirement":"Owners may not discriminate against or harass a person because of source of income (lawful, verifiable income paid to a tenant or on a tenant's behalf, including public assistance and housing subsidies such as Section 8 vouchers and HUD-VASH vouchers). Financial or income standards must account for the aggregate income of persons residing together on the same basis as married persons. Where there is a government rent subsidy, an owner may not use an income standard not based on the portion of rent paid by the tenant, and may not use credit history in the application process without offering the applicant the option to provide lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of ability to pay the tenant's portion of rent (e.g., government benefit payments, pay records, bank statements); if the applicant elects to do so, the housing provider must give reasonable time to respond and reasonably consider the alternative evidence in lieu of credit history. Owners may still inquire about the level or source of income, request information to verify employment, request landlord references and verify identity.","key_value":"Source of income (incl.
